comment: Independent full C-first route frozen from the two prior C-only setup outputs before JavaScript comparison. C identified the wet towel at n on page 2 and the cream pie at o on page 1. The recipe dismisses the inventory pager, wields n, applies cream pie o, then applies towel n. It tests whether C reaches use_cream_pie, ucreamed cleanup in use_towel, and wielded dry_a_towel; input intent alone does not establish those outcomes.
